parts.title: Late arrivals tracking system (e)
parts.text: The school has 850 students. The first lesson starts at 8:30 am. Create a flowchart for counting late students.

scheme.mark_scheme:
1 mark per loop in the range from 1 to 850. (1)
1 mark for checking a time. (1)
1 mark for increment variable “count” (1)
1 mark for displaying the result. (1)
[Max 4]
Do not award the marks for incorrect block shapes.
Do not award full marks for unfinished flowchart.
Accept any suitable answer

points.criterion: Includes a loop in the range from 1 to 850
Checks a time against the first lesson start time
Increments variable count for a late student
Displays the result

scheme.model_answer: START → count=0, time[850] → loop i = 1 to 850 → decision time[i] > 8:30? → if true count=count+1 → next i → OUTPUT count → END.
scheme.ai_instructions: Do not award marks for incorrect block shapes. Do not award full marks for unfinished flowchart. Accept any suitable answer.

parts.text:

parts.title: Logic gates and Boolean logic (c)(i)
parts.text:
Logical expression is given below.

Q₁ = ¬((A + B) · (C + ¬D))

points.criterion: Correctly applies De Morgan's law to split the complemented product
Correctly simplifies ¬(A + B) and ¬(C + ¬D)
Correctly applies double complementation to obtain the final simplified expression

parts.title: Logic gates and Boolean logic (c)(iii)
parts.text:
Draw a logic circuit for the following logical expression.

Q₂ = ¬((A + ¬B) · C)

scheme.mark_scheme:
1 mark for NOT(B) (1)
1 mark for AND (1)
1 mark for OR (1)
1 mark for last NOT (1)
[Max 4]
Do not accept last NOT without output

points.criterion: Includes NOT(B)
Includes AND gate combining the OR result with C
Includes OR gate combining A and NOT(B)
Includes final NOT gate with output

scheme.model_answer: Invert B, OR the result with A, AND that output with C, then invert the AND output to produce Q.

accepted.expression: NOT ((A OR NOT B) AND C)

scheme.ai_instructions: Do not accept last NOT without output.

questions.title: Online store DFD
questions.text:

The customer of the online store has the opportunity to order the desired product through log in. The administrator can add the product to the database.

parts.title: Online store DFD (a)
parts.text: Create a data flow diagram (DFD) of Level 1 based on the description.

scheme.mark_scheme:
define entities (customer, administrator) (1)
define two processes (view product, log in, place an order, add an order) (1)
define two other processes (1)
define data flow (1)
define three data storages (products, customers and administrators, orders) (1)
[Max 5]
Do not accept data flow without labels.
Pay attention to DFD rules.
Do not accept name of process without verbs.

points.criterion: Defines entities (customer, administrator)
Defines two processes such as view product, log in, place an order, add an order
Defines two other processes
Defines labelled data flow
Defines three data storages (products, customers and administrators, orders)

scheme.model_answer: A Level 1 DFD with Customer and Admin entities; processes such as view products, login, make order, add products; labelled data flows such as product details, login and psw, order details and message; and data stores products, user and admin, and orders.
scheme.ai_instructions: Do not accept data flow without labels. Pay attention to DFD rules. Do not accept name of process without verbs. Accept other suitable answers.

An entity cannot provide data to another entity without some processing occurred. (1)
Data cannot move directly from an entity to a data story without being processed. (1)
Data cannot move directly from a data store without being processed. (1)
Data cannot move directly from one data store to another without being processed. (1)
[Max 2]

States a second correct DFD rule about entities/data stores requiring processing between flows

1 An entity cannot provide data to another entity without some processing occurred.
2 Data cannot move directly from one data store to another without being processed.
